hack.protocol_name: Alpha Finance / Alpha Homora V2 (leveraged yield farming)
hack.root_cause: Debt accounting manipulation via rounding bug + public `resolveReserve` function + custom "evil spell"; insider knowledge of unannounced sUSD pool required
hack.description: Alpha Homora V2 lost $37.5M when an attacker with apparent insider knowledge used a rounding bug and a public fee-collection function to create exponentially inflating fake debt, then borrowed $37.5M in real assets across a 13-step attack.
